subject: Model candidate shortlist & traffic snapshot — fit synopsis
messages:
From: Hannah Li <hannah@finlytics.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: Alex Turner <alex.turner@finlytics.com>
Date: 2027-08-22T16:15:00Z
Subject: Workload snapshot + context needs for model recommendation

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — really helpful. Per our conversation, I'm sending a short snapshot of our expected workload so you can recommend a model shortlist and context sizing. High level:

- Product: FinLytics insights (summaries + Q&A over earnings call transcripts)
- Typical document size: 8k–15k tokens (median ~12k)
- Occasional long-batch docs: up to 50k tokens (these would be async batch jobs)
- Expected steady-state traffic: ~200 documents/day (initial), ~8 concurrent interactive users during nightly processing window
- Peak concurrency (after launch): planning for up to 12 concurrent interactive sessions during earnings season
- Target latency for interactive queries: <500ms 95th for short prompts (<1k tokens)
- Primary concerns: cost per doc, maintaining coherence across long transcripts, context window support for 50k+ when needed

Attached: finlytics_token_profile.csv — token counts per document sample and traffic distribution.

Can you advise: 1) 2–3 model candidates we should evaluate for the pilot (tradeoffs: latency vs cost vs context), and 2) suggested context config (window size, chunking strategy) for both interactive and async flows?

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Li
Head of Data Product, FinLytics
hannah@finlytics.com
